elements.note: A bracket over the five air-conditioning ways labelled 'BY ME' -- by the Mechanical Engineer. Those five ways carry NO breaker rating and NO cable size on this sheet; look to the M-01..M-04 sheets.

warnings: The whole electrical installation on one single-line diagram: a 15(45) A single-phase service, about 20 m of buried 2-1/C-10 NYY in ø32 HDPE, a 50 A 2-pole main at 10 kA, and a 14-way consumer unit.
*** CIRCUIT ALLOCATION: 2 lighting (F1-F2), 3 socket (F3-F5), 2 water heater (F6-F7), 5 air-conditioning (F8-F12), 2 SPACE. *** Twelve of fourteen ways used.

*** RCBO WITH 30 mA RESIDUAL PROTECTION ON EVERY SOCKET AND WATER-HEATER CIRCUIT (F3-F7), BUT PLAIN MCBs ON THE LIGHTING (F1-F2). *** That is a deliberate and correct distinction, and it is a price difference of five devices that a take-off reading only 'breaker' will miss.
Water heaters get 20 AT where sockets get 16 AT, on the same 2.5 sq.mm cable.

*** FIVE AIR-CONDITIONING WAYS ARE MARKED 'BY ME' AND CARRY NEITHER A BREAKER RATING NOR A CABLE SIZE ON THIS SHEET -- RESOLVED BY M-01 (PNG 67). *** The mechanical schedule supplies both and the unit count matches exactly five: 2 cassette units in ห้องพักผ่อน/ทานอาหาร at 24,000 BTU/Hr and wall units in ห้องนอน 1, 2 and 3. Breakers are 25AT-1P with 2-4 mm2 + G-2.5 for the 24,000 units and 20AT-1P with 2-2.5 + G-2.5 for the 18,000 units, all at 220/1/50.

TWO WATER-HEATER CIRCUITS CONFIRM THE JWH SYMBOL from EE-01 -- so two heaters are anticipated, one per bathroom. Note this sits against A-29's สุขภัณฑ์ list, which schedules NO water heater at all, and SN-08's basin detail, which calls hot water '(ถ้ามี)'. The electrical set provides for it; the architectural and sanitary sets do not supply it.
EVERY SPECIFIED FINAL CIRCUIT USES THE SAME CABLE -- 2-2.5/G2.5 IEC 01 in ø15 mm PVC -- exactly as EE-01's wiring spec states. There is no lighter lighting circuit anywhere.
The earth conductor is 10 sq.mm, four times any final-circuit conductor, to a ø14.20 x 2.4 m copper rod buried 0.30 m -- matching EE-01's legend.

M-01 also explains why this 14-way board has NO exhaust-fan circuit: the seven exhaust fans are fed from the room LIGHTING circuits, not from a dedicated way. Lighting ways F1 and F2 therefore carry more than the lighting plans alone show.
